agent_command: opencode run --standalone --auto --model zai-coding-plan/glm-5.3 "You are a Baton leg agent. The file named by the BATON_INSTRUCTIONS environment variable holds your instructions for this leg: read them and follow them exactly. The environment names your course (BATON_COURSE), your leg (BATON_LEG), the ticket's file (BATON_TICKET_FILE) and the answer rule for your last line (BATON_ANSWER, when one is set); the arguments after this message are the ticket id, your leg and the repository checkout. Work in the current repository checkout. When BATON_ANSWER is set, a machine parses the LAST line of your output: exactly the value word (optionally followed by one PR URL) and nothing else after it."
